Auth.failed: That didn't work. Check your details and try again.

Auth.notVerified: This account's email is not confirmed yet. Open the link we sent you, or ask for a new one.
Auth.resent: If that address has an account waiting for confirmation, a new link is on its way.
Auth.resendFailed: We couldn't send a new link. Try again in a few minutes.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Auth.verified: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to continue.
Auth.expired: Links work for 1 hour. Enter your email and we'll send a new one.
Auth.invalid: It may have been copied incompletely or already replaced by a newer one. Enter your email and we'll send a new one.

verificationEmail.expiry: The link expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
verificationEmail.ignore: If you didn't create a Pemby account, ignore this email and nothing will happen.

Auth.resetRequest: Enter your email and we'll send a link for setting a new password.

Auth.resetDone: Your password is set and every earlier session was signed out.
Auth.resetLinkInvalid: Links work for 1 hour and only once. Ask for a new one below.

resetPasswordEmail.subject: Reset your Pemby password

resetPasswordEmail.ignore: If this wasn't you, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.
